description: Rocky/RHEL host, privileged (opted in): root login and password auth on, X11 forwarding on, no password expiry, a legacy MD5 password hash, a never-expiring password, an unexpected setuid-root binary (/usr/local/bin/rootshell), a system account with a login shell (svc, uid 150), ip_forward enabled, ptrace unrestricted, suid_dumpable on, unprivileged BPF on, telnet listening, rpcbind enabled. firewalld/auditd/rsyslog on. apt-get is absent (the apt updates check is skipped as not applicable).
